summary.text: Anne Carney is a Democratic state senator from Maine Senate District 29 who took office on December 1, 2020, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney, she served in the Maine House of Representatives from 2018 to 2020.

paragraphs.text: Anne Carney was born in Baltimore, Maryland, and lives in Cape Elizabeth, Maine.
She earned a B.A. from Haverford College, a master's degree in theological studies from Harvard University, and a law degree from the University of Maine in 1990.

Her career experience includes working as a lawyer with Norman, Hanson & DeTroy and as an in-house volunteer attorney with Pine Tree Legal Assistance, and she served on the board of directors of the Cape Elizabeth Land Trust.
Carney represented House District 30 from 2018 to 2020 before being elected to the Senate.
